shortDescription: Sophon plans to carry out the final shutdown of its mainnet on November 30, 2026, with key infrastructure and related websites scheduled to begin closing after November 25. According to ChainCatcher, assets remaining on Sophon Chain after the deadline could become permanently inaccessible.
